newsitem.title: USA: Butler National to wins contract.
newsitem.headline: Butler National to wins contract.

text.p: Butler National Corp said Wednesday the National Indian Gaming Commission has approved a management contract between the Miami and Medoc tribes of Oklahoma and Butler National Service Corp.
The contract provides for construction and operation of a Class II (high stakes Bingo) and Class III (off-track betting) Indian gaming establishment to be known as the Stables.

Butler National, as manager, will receive a 30 percent share of the profits. Tribal leaders have pledged two percent of their gaming proceeds to the State of Oklahoma and two percent to Ottawa County, Okla. in exchange for services to be provided to the establishment.
Butler National operates in the services and aerospace business segments.
